test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. These fields in the countryside have often been treated with pesticides which are harmful to bees.

B. There is a new buzz in towns and cities in Great Britain.

C. Bee-keepers living in the towns have begun to outnumber those in the country because plants growing in towns can offer more exciting nectar than fields in the countryside.

D. Bee-keeping, normally practised by people living in the country, has become a fashionable hobby for those who live and work in the cities.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'BDCA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Statement B will come first as it explains an event that is happening in the cities and towns of Great Britain.
 
• Statement D will follow statement B as it mentions the event i.e. 'bee-keeping' which is happening in the cities and towns of Great Britain.
 
• Statement C will follow statement D as it mentions the number of bee-keepers in the city.
 
• Statement A will come as it adds information about the fields mentioned in sentence C.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

The final sequence will be: 

 
• B: There is a new buzz in towns and cities in Great Britain.
 
• D: Bee-keeping, normally practised by people living in the country, has become a fashionable hobby for those who live and work in the cities.
 
• C: Bee-keepers living in the towns have begun to outnumber those in the country because plants growing in towns can offer more exciting nectar than fields in the countryside.
 
• A: These fields in the countryside have often been treated with pesticides which are harmful to bees.
